common constant tempo map

  • CURIE: gmeow:tempoMapCommon
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tempoMapCommon
  • Category: individual
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

A simple constant TempoMap used by the meter fixtures: one quarter-note beat in musicalTimeFrameCommon maps to one half-second in TAI (e.g. quarter = 120). The solver interprets the ratio relative to the declared frames.

Structure

Types: gmeow:TempoMap

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:tempoMapCommon as a controlled value typed as gmeow:TempoMap.
